integrity: Classical geometric-renewal transforms, bare telegraph boundary returns, and the heavy-tail minimum-exponent principle are acknowledged prior methodology. The new assertion is the jointly scaled critical crossover and its explicitly calibrated consequences. No authorship, certification, or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unbiased one-dimensional run-and-tumble motion on a half-line; independent Poisson tumbles and bulk resetting; complete renewal after each binding; bound duration with 1/2-index Laplace tail; fixed reset ratio R and weak absorption probability theta. No uniform limit for divergent R, no arbitrary correlations or nonlinear state dependence.
title: A critical resetting crossover for sticky run-and-tumble absorption
